scope: Reproduce false rejection of two custom duration types by the KERNEL-023 public validator; neither type specializes ISQ::DurationValue. This record is diagnostic evidence, not complete trigger-rule qualification.

documents.name: tests/conformance/fixtures/trigger-arguments-positive.sysml

review: The pinned rule requires a ScalarQuantityValue result with a feature redefining TensorQuantityValue::mRef and specializing DurationUnit. CustomDuration declares those conditions, and InheritedDuration inherits them. Requiring the narrower nominal DurationValue type incorrectly rejects both. Generated result.feature was separately found empty, which must be repaired before validating the actual result graph.
